entities.name: Dragan Labović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dragan Labović was a Serbian professional basketball player. A native of Prokuplje and a 2.07 m tall power forward, he rose to prominence during his teenage years, where he won four gold medals for the youth Serbian national basketball teams. He also represented the senior national team.
